p.title: v60.03 a refused chat request is retried without tools only when the refusal is about the tools
p.symptom: Any 400 from the Worker made the chat send the same question a second time without its data tools (plan 045), so a request the Worker refused for another reason was sent twice; the screener AI conditions browser gate saw two answer requests where one is the contract.
p.root_cause: createToolSession.refused took the fallback on the status alone.
p.fix: src/ai/tools/loop.js: the fallback needs a 400 whose error text names tools, functions, search or a schema; js/aio-chat.js passes the error text it already read. The headless test T773 reads the search guidance from the tool registry's prompt block instead of a removed sentence.
p.violated_rule: One question is one paid request unless a retry can change the outcome.
p.prevention: ci-ai-chat-reliability-contract-check: a 400 that is not about the tools is one request and one error; a tools refusal is retried once; ci-screener-ai-conditions-browser-check keeps its exactly-one-request rule.

changelog: **A refused question is not sent twice ({P}):** the retry without data tools happens only when the refusal is about the tools.
note: v60.03: tool fallback only for tool refusals
